C1.rule: Mechanical, one owned file, fully specified, no design choice

C2.rule: Bounded implementation or tests, clear spec, one or two owned files and their tests

C3.rule: Cross-module design; changes a gate or the ledger contract; wrong means every project inherits it

C4.rule: Planning, merging, reconciling, anything in a project's real data, a sponsor decision

phases.name: Levers
phases.goal: The levers the sponsor picked on the Eight Levers page become rules and tools every project on the standard follows.
phases.exit: L-01 to L-06 merged; the same transcript measurement rerun on one project shows lead context and review spend down.

phases.name: Research
phases.goal: Questions that need reading, not writing, before they become items, a proposal, or a decline.
phases.exit: Every X row is done only when it becomes items, a numbered proposal, or a recorded decline with the reason -- never a report nobody acted on.

items.title: Fresh lead per milestone or day
items.what: A lead session ends at a milestone or at the end of a day and the next one starts from /warmup and the checkpoint. The lead's context stays under about 150k tokens. The safeguards that keep this from dropping anything, and keep work continuing without the sponsor, are proposal 24 (X-03).
items.done: The rule is in CLAUDE-workflow.md with a Standard change line; a rerun of the transcript measurement on one project shows lead spend above 500k context below 10%.

log.evidence: Sponsor ask A-14. Dispatched to a Sonnet code-engineer in its own worktree, branch l-levers-rules from origin/main ba01418; ruflo-item start L-01 recorded (namespace patterns). Integration branch p23-levers.

items.title: Review only risky work
items.what: A separate reviewer runs only for money, data safety, cross-cutting changes and release merges. Everything else goes build, gate, land. Replaces the report-only-reviewer-on-every-item step in HANDOFF 'What good looks like'. Which items count as risky is set by the risk class from proposal 25 (X-01).
items.done: Rule and brief template changed with a Standard change line; review and fix agents fall below 10% of subagent spend on a rerun, with no rise in defects found after merge.

log.evidence: Sponsor ask A-14. Dispatched to a Sonnet code-engineer in its own worktree, branch l-levers-rules from origin/main ba01418; ruflo-item start L-02 recorded (namespace patterns). Integration branch p23-levers.

items.title: Quiet builds: log to file, read the summary line
items.what: Test, analyzer and build output goes to a file. Agents read only the summary line (^OK and no ^FAILED, analyzer counts). The brief template says so and a helper prints the verdict in one line. Mining found 138 raw flutter test runs bypassing tools/gate.sh (~124k tokens) and 23 raw unittest runs; the helper and rule cover both.
items.done: Helper in bin/ with tests, including a red run that proves a FAILED line is caught; brief template updated.

log.evidence: Sponsor ask A-14. Dispatched to a Sonnet code-engineer in its own worktree, branch l-03-quiet from origin/main ba01418; ruflo-item start L-03 recorded (namespace patterns). Integration branch p23-levers.

items.title: One-line tracker commands for ledger updates
items.what: bin/tracker gains a command that sets an item's status and appends a log entry, then validates, renders and prints one line. Leads stop writing inline python against ledger JSON. Independent transcript mining (2026-09-15) found 341 inline load-ledger/set/dump scripts (~386k tokens) plus 369 more generic JSON load/dump scripts across the three sessions: this command is the largest repeat to remove.
items.done: Command with tests (red first); OPERATING-RULES names it; one lead session uses it for a full item.

log.evidence: Sponsor ask A-14. Dispatched to a Sonnet code-engineer in its own worktree, branch l-04-tracker-set from origin/main ba01418; ruflo-item start L-04 recorded (namespace patterns). Integration branch p23-levers.

items.title: Bundle small issues by surface
items.what: Small issues on the same screen or module go to one agent in one worktree: one commit per issue, one gate run, one PR closing all of them. Parallel agents only for areas that do not touch. The bundle is picked from the catalogue (X-02).
items.done: Brief template has a bundle form; CLAUDE-workflow.md Issues section updated with a Standard change line.

log.evidence: Sponsor ask A-14. Dispatched to a Sonnet code-engineer in its own worktree, branch l-levers-rules from origin/main ba01418; ruflo-item start L-05 recorded (namespace patterns). Integration branch p23-levers.

items.title: Haiku scout writes the context pack
items.what: Before a builder starts, a Haiku scout maps the files, line ranges and recall hits the item needs and writes them into the brief's CONTEXT section. The builder starts with its reading done.
items.done: A scout brief template and the CONTEXT pack format exist; one item run with a scout shows builder read and inspect spend lower than a comparable item without.

log.evidence: Sponsor ask A-14. Dispatched to a Sonnet code-engineer in its own worktree, branch l-levers-rules from origin/main ba01418; ruflo-item start L-06 recorded (namespace patterns). Integration branch p23-levers.

items.title: Size items by value, points and risk (sponsor's L8 note)
items.what: Research done 2026-09-15 by a report-only agent: value set by the sponsor, Fibonacci points by the lead calibrated against measured cost per item, a risk class from paths, routing review depth and effort rather than model. Becomes proposal 25 with the four open questions as decisions.
items.done: Proposal 25 exists with its decisions, or the sponsor declines it.

log.evidence: Report-only research-agent (sonnet) returned: WSJF-style value/points/risk scheme, 2 alternatives, 4 sponsor questions. LLM story-point accuracy evidence is thin (arXiv 2603.06276, 2604.03443).
Became proposal 25, accepted 2026-09-15 (D1-D6 all option A); items Z-01 to Z-06.

items.title: Catalogue and cluster issues for later (sponsor's L2 and L5 notes)
items.what: Every issue that is not taken now is catalogued with a surface cluster (file-path overlap first), so bundles for L-05 can be picked from it. Designed inside proposal 25, because the cluster field sits beside value, points and risk.
items.done: Proposal 25 covers the catalogue and cluster fields, or the sponsor declines it.

log.evidence: Covered by proposal 25 D6 (catalogue clustered by files touched) → Z-06.

items.title: Autonomous work without missing anything (sponsor's L1 note)
items.what: A separate proposal, as the sponsor asked: how short-lived leads hand over without losing asks, findings or in-flight work, and how work keeps moving without him.
items.done: Proposal 24 is filled in with its options and decisions.

log.evidence: Became proposal 24, accepted 2026-09-15 (D1 B, D2-D4 A); items H-01 to H-03.

items.title: Use the existing tool, not an inline copy
items.what: Transcript mining found agents re-doing what tools already do: sed -n and cat instead of the Read tool (295 uses, ~150k tokens), hand-appended HANDOFF and AGENT-LOG entries instead of spend and remember (158, ~85k), raw flutter test instead of gate.sh (138, ~124k). The brief template and OPERATING-RULES name the tool for each.
items.done: Brief template MUST lines added with a Standard change line; a rerun of the mining script shows each cluster down by half.
